title: State of Andhra Pradesh v. Rayavarapu Punnayya

content.caseIdentity: State of Andhra Pradesh v. Rayavarapu Punnayya, (1976) 4 SCC 382
content.holding: Formulated the authoritative tripartite test: (1) Did the accused cause death with any state of mind in Section 100? (2) If yes, does it fall in clauses (a)-(d) of Section 101? (3) If yes, does any statutory Exception apply to reduce it to culpable homicide not amounting to murder?
content.relevance: Mandatory three-step judicial filter applied by all trial and appellate courts in homicide adjudications.
